name: Tooya
source:
A youth of a tribe with a strange culture called the "Tsuchigumo".
He is feared for being able to use his magical singing voice to communicate with spirits.
He lived deep in the forest and stayed away from people for the sake of his tribe so he is not good at dealing with people.
However he has a pure heart.

He is technically the first Genbu of Heaven of the series.
His particular trait is "Belief".
